value.text: Reinvent productivity and business processes to help organizations and individuals work and collaborate more securely and efficiently.

strategic_priorities.quote: Reinvent productivity and business processes to help organizations and individuals work and collaborate more securely and efficiently.

value.text: Build the intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform to provide a foundation for our customers' digital workloads including hybrid consistency, developer productivity, data and AI capabilities, and trusted security and compliance.

strategic_priorities.quote: Build the intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform to provide a foundation for our customers’ digital workloads including hybrid consistency, developer productivity, data and AI capabilities, and trusted security and compliance.

value.text: Create more personal computing to enable users to interact with technology in more intuitive, engaging, and dynamic ways.

strategic_priorities.quote: Create more personal computing to enable users to interact with technology in more intuitive, engaging, and dynamic ways.

value.text: Focused on helping customers use the breadth and depth of the Microsoft Cloud to get the most value out of their digital spend while leading the AI platform wave across our solution areas; goal is to lead the industry in several distinct areas of technology over the long term.

strategic_priorities.quote: We are focused on helping customers use the breadth and depth of the Microsoft Cloud to get the most value out of their digital spend while leading the AI platform wave across our solution areas.

value.text: Transforming the workplace to deliver new, modern, modular business applications, drive deeper insights, and improve how people communicate, collaborate, learn, work, and interact with one another.

strategic_priorities.quote: Transforming the workplace to deliver new, modern, modular business applications, drive deeper insights, and improve how people communicate, collaborate, learn, work, and interact with one another.

value.text: Building and running cloud-based services in ways that utilize ubiquitous computing to unleash new experiences and opportunities for businesses and individuals.

strategic_priorities.quote: Building and running cloud-based services in ways that utilize ubiquitous computing to unleash new experiences and opportunities for businesses and individuals.

value.text: Applying AI and ambient intelligence to drive insights, revolutionize many types of work and business processes, and provide substantive productivity gains using Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents.

strategic_priorities.quote: Applying AI and ambient intelligence to drive insights, revolutionize many types of work and business processes, and provide substantive productivity gains using Microsoft 365 Copilot and agents.

value.text: Providing training on generative AI and greater access to digital learning and resources through skilling programs and initiatives, grants, and LinkedIn learning pathways.

strategic_priorities.quote: Providing training on generative AI and greater access to digital learning and resources through skilling programs and initiatives, grants, and LinkedIn learning pathways.

value.text: Inventing new gaming experiences that bring people together around their shared love for games on any device and pushing the boundaries of innovation with console and PC gaming.

strategic_priorities.quote: Inventing new gaming experiences that bring people together around their shared love for games on any device and pushing the boundaries of innovation with console and PC gaming.

value.text: Leveraging Windows to fuel our cloud business, grow our share of the PC market, and drive increased engagement with our services.

strategic_priorities.quote: Leveraging Windows to fuel our cloud business, grow our share of the PC market, and drive increased engagement with our services like Microsoft Edge, Bing, Copilot, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 Consumer, Xbox Game Pass, and more.

value.text: Tackling security from all angles with our integrated, end-to-end solutions spanning security, compliance, identity, and management, across all clouds and platforms.

strategic_priorities.quote: Tackling security from all angles with our integrated, end-to-end solutions spanning security, compliance, identity, and management, across all clouds and platforms.

value.text: We prioritize security above all else and offer customers integrated AI-driven products addressing security, compliance, identity, management, and privacy.

strategic_priorities.quote: We prioritize security above all else and we offer our customers integrated AI-driven products addressing security, compliance, identity, management, and privacy across customers’ multi-cloud, application, and device assets.

value.text: Commitment to designing and deploying AI responsibly with safety and security from the outset.

strategic_priorities.quote: We believe AI should be as empowering as it is powerful, and we’re committed to designing and deploying AI responsibly with safety and security from the outset.

value.text: Sustainability: goals announced in 2020 to become a carbon negative, water positive, and zero waste company by 2030.

strategic_priorities.quote: In 2020, we announced goals to become a carbon negative, water positive, and zero waste company by 2030.

value.text: Plan to continue to make significant investments in a broad range of product research and development activities, coordinated across operating segments, including continuing to support fundamental research.

strategic_priorities.quote: We plan to continue to make significant investments in a broad range of product research and development activities, and as appropriate, we will coordinate our research and development across operating segments and leverage the results across the company.

value.text: Continue to align our datacenter locations and server capacity to meet the evolving needs of our customers, particularly given the growing demand for AI services.

strategic_priorities.quote: We continue to align our datacenter locations and server capacity to meet the evolving needs of our customers, particularly given the growing demand for AI services.

value.text: Future growth depends on our ability to transcend current product category definitions, business models, and sales motions.

strategic_priorities.quote: Our future growth depends on our ability to transcend current product category definitions, business models, and sales motions.

value.text: three core business priorities as our North Star: security, quality, and AI innovation

To deliver on our mission, we remain focused on three core business priorities as our North Star: security, quality, and
AI innovation.

value.text: Delivering current platforms at scale while building the next generation

strategic_priorities.quote:
We are delivering our current platforms at scale while building the next generation, always striving to
create more value for our customers, our partners, and the world.

value.text: Continue to lead the AI infrastructure wave — datacenter and capacity expansion

strategic_priorities.quote:
We continue to lead the AI infrastructure wave. We opened new datacenters across six continents and now operate
more than 400 datacenters in 70 regions, more than any other cloud provider.

value.text: Two foundational areas of AI innovation: Cloud and AI infrastructure, and the family of Copilots and agents

At the same time, we have made major advances in AI innovation, including across two foundational areas: our Cloud
and AI infrastructure, and our family of Copilots and agents.

value.text: Investing in sovereign cloud offerings for data residency needs

strategic_priorities.quote:
And we continue to invest in sovereign cloud offerings to meet the unique data
residency needs of governments and industries worldwide.

value.text: Being Customer Zero — applying AI to our own work and sharing the playbook

strategic_priorities.quote:
We are focused on being Customer Zero, applying AI to reduce toil and improve flow in our own work while creating
a playbook we can share with the world.

value.text: A new way of working that expands job scopes and reduces handoffs

strategic_priorities.quote:
We’re also embracing a new way of working—one that expands job scopes, reduces handoffs, and gives teams tools
to scale productivity in nonlinear ways.

value.text: Skilling and opportunity commitment through Microsoft Elevate

Over the next five
years, we will invest $4 billion in cash and AI cloud technology to schools, community and technical colleges, and
nonprofit organizations.

value.text: Driving responsible AI innovation and building safe and secure technology

strategic_priorities.quote:
That’s why we are committed to driving
responsible AI innovation and building safe and secure technology. As we do, we are guided by our values of respect,
integrity, and accountability.

value.text: Sustainability commitments: carbon negative, water positive, zero waste, protect more land than we use

strategic_priorities.quote:
2025 also marked the midpoint in our journey to become a carbon negative, water positive, zero waste company,
and to protect more land than we use.

value.name: Productivity and Business Processes
value.note: Document states segment composition changes announced in August 2024, most notably bringing the commercial components of Microsoft 365 together in this segment, effective beginning fiscal year 2025.

segments.quote: These changes align our segments with how we currently manage our business, most notably bringing the commercial components of Microsoft 365 together in the Productivity and Business Processes segment.
We operate our business and report our financial performance using three segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing.
Our More Personal Computing segment consists of products and services that put customers at the center of the experience with our technology.

value.name: Productivity and Business Processes
value.note: Commercial components of Microsoft 365 brought together in this segment beginning fiscal year 2025; prior period segment information recast.

segments.quote: These changes align our segments with how we currently manage our business, most notably bringing the commercial components of Microsoft 365 together in the Productivity and Business Processes segment. Beginning in fiscal year 2025, the information that our chief operating decision maker is regularly provided and reviews for purposes of allocating resources and assessing performance reflects these segment changes. Prior period segment information has been recast to conform to the way we internally manage and monitor our business during fiscal year 2025.

value.name: Windows OEM and Devices
value.note: Windows OEM and Devices combined into a single revenue growth metric bringing PC market-driven businesses together.

segments.quote: Other changes include combining Windows OEM and Devices into a single revenue growth metric that brings revenue from PC market-driven businesses together, as well as elevating our cloud revenue growth metrics to align to our strategic focus on cloud growth.
We report our financial performance based on the following segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing.

value.description: Announced changes to segment composition, most notably bringing commercial components of Microsoft 365 into Productivity and Business Processes; effective beginning fiscal year 2025 with prior periods recast.

events.quote: In August 2024, we announced changes to the composition of our segments. These changes align our segments with how we currently manage our business, most notably bringing the commercial components of Microsoft 365 together in the Productivity and Business Processes segment.

value.description: Metric definition changes made in Q1 FY2025 in connection with the segment changes, including a new Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud revenue growth metric and combining Windows OEM and Devices into a single metric.

events.quote: In the first quarter of fiscal year 2025, we made updates to our metrics in connection with the segment changes described above. These changes align our metrics with how we manage and monitor certain businesses. The key change was bringing the commercial components of Microsoft 365 together and creating a new Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud revenue growth metric.

value.description: Activision Blizzard acquisition affected Gaming revenue and operating expenses in fiscal year 2025.

events.quote: Operating expenses increased $3.8 billion or 6% driven by investments in cloud and AI engineering and Gaming, including the impact of the Activision Blizzard acquisition.

value.description: Microsoft 365 Consumer price increase announced in January 2025 drove growth in revenue per user.

events.quote: Microsoft 365 Consumer cloud revenue grew 11% driven by Microsoft 365 Consumer subscriber growth of 8% to 89.0 million, as well as growth in revenue per user from the price increase announced in January 2025.

value.description: IRS Notices of Proposed Adjustment seeking $28.9 billion in additional tax plus penalties and interest for tax years 2004 to 2013, which Microsoft will contest.

events.quote: With respect to the audit for tax years 2004 to 2013, on September 26, 2023, we received Notices of Proposed Adjustment (“NOPAs”) from the IRS. The primary issues in the NOPAs relate to intercompany transfer pricing. In the NOPAs, the IRS is seeking an additional tax payment of $28.9 billion plus penalties and interest.

value.description: Enactment of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, which Microsoft is assessing; provides a GILTI effective tax rate of 14% effective fiscal year 2027.

events.quote: We are currently assessing the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (“OBBBA”) which was enacted on July 4, 2025. The OBBBA provides a U.S. global intangible low-taxed income effective tax rate of 14% effective fiscal year 2027 for Microsoft.

value.description: Share repurchases of 31 million shares for $13.0 billion in fiscal year 2025, with $57.3 billion remaining of the $60 billion program.

events.quote: During fiscal years 2025 and 2024, we repurchased 31 million shares and 32 million shares of our common stock for $13.0 billion and $12.0 billion, respectively, through our share repurchase program. All repurchases were made using cash resources. As of June 30, 2025, $57.3 billion remained of our $60 billion share repurchase program.

value.description: Eighth and final TCJA transition tax installment of $4.4 billion payable in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026.

events.quote: As of June 30, 2025, our eighth transition tax installment of $4.4 billion is short-term and payable in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026.

value.description: Pillar Two global minimum tax legislation applies to Microsoft beginning in fiscal year 2025.

events.quote: Many countries have implemented or are in the process of implementing the Pillar Two legislation, which applies to Microsoft beginning in fiscal year 2025.

value.description: Expected impairment charge of approximately $800 million in Q2 FY2025 on Microsoft's minority investment in Cruise, after GM announced its intent to realign its autonomous driving strategy and no longer fund Cruise's robotaxi development work; estimated negative impact of approximately $0.09 to second quarter diluted EPS, and not included in the second quarter guidance provided on October 30, 2024.

events.quote: On December 10, 2024, GM announced its intent to realign its autonomous driving strategy, no longer fund Cruise’s robotaxi development work, and pursue the acquisition of minority investor shares. As a result, we expect to record an impairment charge of approximately $800 million in the second quarter of fiscal year 2025.

value.description: 2024 Annual Shareholders Meeting held; all 12 director nominees re-elected, say-on-pay approved on an advisory basis, and Deloitte & Touche LLP ratified as independent registered public accounting firm for fiscal year 2025; six shareholder proposals were not approved.

events.quote: On December 10, 2024, Microsoft Corporation (the “Company” or “Microsoft”) held its 2024 Annual Shareholders Meeting (the “Annual Meeting”). There were 7,434,436,393 shares of common stock entitled to be voted at the Annual Meeting, of which 6,417,206,480 were voted in person or by proxy.

value.why_notable: Self-characterisation places AI at the centre of the company's identity and product framing, alongside the long-recurring mission statement.

notable_language.quote: Microsoft is a technology company committed to making digital technology and artificial intelligence (“AI”) available broadly and doing so responsibly, with a mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We create platforms and tools, powered by AI, that deliver innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of our customers.

value.why_notable: An unusually direct admission that the AI capital cycle pressures costs and margins.

notable_language.quote: The investments we are making in cloud and AI infrastructure and devices will continue to increase our operating costs and may decrease our operating margins.

value.why_notable: Explicitly attributes a named margin decline to AI infrastructure scaling — a concrete cost of the AI build-out repeated across segments.

notable_language.quote: Microsoft Cloud gross margin percentage decreased to 69% driven by the impact of scaling our AI infrastructure, offset in part by efficiency gains in Azure.

value.why_notable: Frames physical constraints — land, energy, GPUs — as dependencies of the growth story, a comparatively new emphasis for a software company.

notable_language.quote: Our datacenters depend on the availability of permitted and buildable land, predictable energy, networking supplies, and servers, including graphics processing units (“GPUs”) and other components.

value.why_notable: A dedicated description of the OpenAI relationship in Industry Trends, characterising IP rights, exclusivity and a right of first refusal in management's own terms.

notable_language.quote: Microsoft and OpenAI maintain a long-term strategic partnership originally established in 2019. Microsoft is a major investor in OpenAI, and the companies have reciprocal revenue-sharing arrangements. We hold rights to OpenAI’s intellectual property, including models and infrastructure, for integration into our products.

value.why_notable: Names OpenAI as a driver of a materially larger 'Other, net' loss — the partnership described as an opportunity also appearing as an earnings drag.

notable_language.quote: Other, net primarily reflects net recognized losses on equity method investments, including OpenAI.

value.why_notable: Explicit tariff and trade-policy language in the MD&A risk framing.

segments_basis.basis: reportable segments as named by the filing

investor_qa_basis.basis: management's written answers to questions submitted by investors, published roughly monthly. Same verification as every other fact — whole-document boundaries and a checked quote — but a different kind of evidence from a 10-K or proxy statement: unaudited, unprompted by any disclosure requirement, and responsive to whatever was asked. Corroborating; not a substitute for a filed disclosure.

ids.basis: content hash of the claim, its evidence and its source — see `fact_id` in src/equity_research/ledger_schema.py. Confidence and the verification result are NOT hashed, so re-verifying a fact does not renumber it. Cross-year uniqueness is enforced fatally at build time by `audit_ids`.

document_window.basis: filing dates of the documents this year's facts are actually drawn from — NOT the fiscal window in inventory.json, which bounds the fiscal years in scope. Documents reporting on a fiscal year are filed after it ends, so this range extends past window_end_date by construction. Any accession listed above additionally belongs to a fiscal year outside the window and is used deliberately: an annual-meeting vote held in May of year N decides on year N-1.

corrections.basis: config/corrections.toml — human corrections to model-extracted values that the cited filing contradicts, each carrying the filing text that establishes it. data/ledger/facts/ is never edited: the record of what the model returned has to stay as it was.
